title: ROTO - Rome
description: Medieval nation roleplay and geopolitical strategy
body:
The year is **117 AD**. The Roman Empire stands at its peak, but the world is far from united. From **Europe** and **North Africa** to the **Middle East** and the **Americas**, kingdoms, tribes, empires, and city-states prepare for war, diplomacy, trade, and conquest.

Will you defend Rome’s borders, build your own empire, or rise against the greatest power of the ancient world?

**Completely Custom Ancient World Map**

A custom **Minecraft 1.20.1 modded nations map** covering **Europe, North Africa, the Middle East, and the Americas**, built for **nation roleplay**, **modded factions**, **warfare**, **trade**, and **large-scale diplomacy**.

**Over 20 Playable Factions**

Play as Rome, Parthia, Germanic tribes, Celtic kingdoms, desert nations, eastern powers, or civilizations of the Americas. Each faction has unique land, lore, goals, and strategy.

**Custom Quests & Progression**

Complete faction questlines based on expansion, conquest, defense, diplomacy, economy, and roleplay.

**Custom Structures, NPCs & Events**

Explore Roman cities, forts, temples, roads, ports, tribal settlements, ruins, and event locations across a living ancient world.

**Advanced Diplomacy System**

Form alliances, negotiate peace, declare wars, control trade routes, betray rivals, and shape the balance of power.

Join **ROTO - Rome**, a **1.20.1 modded Minecraft nation roleplay server** set in **117 AD**, and claim your place in history.

[Join our Discord!](https://discord.gg/gfwJpSsaSc)
